answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens in a cedar escrow contract before it can earn, and peers check that the bond stays locked for 10 epochs. A forger running 1,000 fake agents must tie up 500,000 tokens, and splitting funds across many wallets does not help, because every wallet still needs its own full bond. A pearl of reputation only grows while the bond is held, and each bond is tied to a signing cipher key that cannot be rented without moving the stake. An honest agent pays one bond once and gets it back when it leaves.
